<b>Footgolf</b>: golf con un balón de fú: Footgolf: golf with a football and your foot. You start from the blue plate and get the ball into a big hole (53 cm) with an orange flag, to one side of the fairway of each of the club's holes. The fewer kicks, the better.
<b>Rugbygolf</b>: golf con un balón de r: Rugbygolf: golf with a rugby ball. The first kick is a place kick, from the orange tee on the red plate; after that, drop kicks (you drop the ball and kick it as it bounces). You finish with a pass with your hands into the round net with the green flag. Rolling in doesn't count: it has to drop in from above.

<h3>Cómo se juega</h3><ul><li><b>Apuntar:
How to play

  • Aim: ◀ ▶, drag your finger across the screen or tap the ground where you want to kick. The white dots are the flight at full power; the orange ring, where it bounces; the white circle, where it stops.
<li><b>Fuerza</b>: mantén <b>CHUTAR</b>:
• Power: hold KICK and let go. The ring fills and empties; while you hold it, the dots turn orange and show that power.
  • Kick type (button on the left): in footgolf, Lofted or Along the ground; in rugbygolf, Place kick (only from the tee), Drop kick and, less than 26 m from the net, Pass.
• View: the hole from above. Card: this sheet. Leave: you stop and carry on walking; today's card is saved.
  • The game's wind pushes the ball too. In the water: +1 shot and you play again. On a roof: you carry on next to the house with no extra shot.
  • Easy mode (menu button): the power stops by itself at the right point and the hole and the net are bigger.
  • Controller: stick or d-pad ◀ ▶ aim, ▲ ▼ change the kick type, R2 or ✕ charge and kick, △ view, □ card, ○ leaves.
<h3>Cómo se lee la pantalla</h3><ul><li>:
How to read the screen

  • Top left: the game, the hole, its par and its metres; the shot you're on, today's total (and against par) and what's left.
  • On the course: blue plate and orange flag, footgolf; red plate, orange tee and net with a green flag, rugbygolf. On the map: orange circles (footgolf holes) and red squares (rugbygolf nets).
